name: What are the main cost factors for adding a new primary bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What are the main cost factors for adding a new primary bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a primary bathroom addition is influenced by several factors, including its size, the quality of materials selected, and the complexity of plumbing and electrical work. Higher-end fixtures, custom cabinetry, and extensive tile work will increase the overall investment. A practical tradeoff is balancing desired luxury with budget, as premium selections can significantly escalate costs compared to standard options. We provide detailed estimates to help you understand these cost drivers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost factors for a primary bathroom addition include size, material quality, and plumbing/electrical complexity. Choosing higher-end finishes is a key tradeoff that can increase the budget.
